notes: הַר → the hill country heads on hill, since country alone is any country while hill carries the lexeme (rule 31); the the before it is supplied on the construct (rule 29).
In הַר הָעֲמָלֵקִי the ASV writes a the before each noun, so nothing is fronted: the article takes the the standing before its own word and the rectum's of is discontinuous around it (rules 29, 25).
בְּ before הַר keeps its own in and the pair is not fused, the ASV having spent words on each (rules 2, 30).
